import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('acf_tanf_caseload_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='TFam', header=None)

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('acf_tanf_caseload_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='FY2023-Recipients', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'state'].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).replace('\n', ' ').strip() for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]
df = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
cal_row = df[df['State'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'california'].iloc[0]
adults = float(cal_row['Adults'])
children = float(cal_row['Children'])
result = 'yes' if children > adults else 'no'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('acf_tanf_caseload_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='FY2023-Families', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'state'].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).replace('\n', ' ').strip() for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]
df = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
df = df[~df['State'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().str.contains('total|notes|fiscal|nan')]
df = df.dropna(subset=['State'])
tot_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'total' in c.lower()][0]
df[tot_col] = pd.to_numeric(df[tot_col], errors='coerce')
df = df.dropna(subset=[tot_col])
result = str(df.loc[df[tot_col].idxmax(), 'State']).strip()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('acf_tanf_caseload_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='FY2023-Recipients', header=None)

df = df.dropna(subset=[tot_col])
top3 = df.sort_values(by=tot_col, ascending=False).head(3)['State'].tolist()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('acf_tanf_caseload_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Children', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'state'].index[0]
headers = df.iloc[header_idx].tolist()
us_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'u.s. totals'].iloc[0]

month_cols = []
for idx, h in enumerate(headers):
    h_str = str(h).strip().lower()
    if any(m in h_str for m in ['oct', 'nov', 'dec', 'jan', 'feb', 'mar', 'apr', 'may', 'jun', 'jul', 'aug', 'sep']):
        month_cols.append((idx, str(h).strip()))

month_data = {col_name: float(us_row[col_idx]) for col_idx, col_name in month_cols}
min_month = min(month_data, key=month_data.get)
dt = pd.to_datetime(min_month, format='%b-%y')
result = dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
